prediction_moment: After material fabrication and pre-cycle characterization, before the requested long cycling test.

scope.material: biomass carbon main; residue-inclusive sensitivity separately declared
scope.not_a_feature: Scope predicates and evidence gates are not one-hot shortcuts for mixing incompatible systems.

required_physical_inputs.name: cycle_count
required_physical_inputs.label: 计划预测的循环次数
required_physical_inputs.reason: Defines the prediction horizon; not an observed failure cycle or achieved test length at inference.

required_physical_inputs.name: reported_current_A_g
required_physical_inputs.label: 作者报告的循环电流（质量口径不齐）
required_physical_inputs.normalization_metadata_required: Keep unknown denominator explicit; literal reported descriptor, not calibrated physical stress.

required_physical_inputs.name: electrolyte
required_physical_inputs.label: 电解液种类
required_physical_inputs.transform: one-hot fitted on training groups only

required_physical_inputs.name: BET_m2_g
required_physical_inputs.label: 循环前成品BET比表面积
required_physical_inputs.method: N2-BET; CO2-DFT or unqualified surface area not substituted

optional_physical_inputs.name: total_pore_volume_cm3_g
optional_physical_inputs.label: 循环前成品总孔体积
optional_physical_inputs.policy: Only plus_BET_pore. Missing allowed with fold-only imputation/indicator. Micropore volume is not total volume; ambiguous printed unit remains missing.

process_only_route: A separate future route can use feedstock/activation/carbonization parameters plus requested test conditions. It may not require measured BET. No process-only model is currently claimed ready; evidence must support stage and ratio definitions.
definition_change_from_v03: Drop concentration unit from categorical predictors after exact unit canonicalization.
Require actual BET for the primary material prediction and keep a same-cohort protocol comparator.
Fix seven core plus one optional input instead of leaving an unexplained list of alternatives.
r4 distinguishes reported-current empirical model from calibrated-current model; old canonical admission not overwritten.
current_unit_policy: Unknown is retained. Never infer, convert or impute the current denominator. Canonical-current view is separate.
admission_policy: Strict canonical current basis; field-scoped optional issues masked before use; missing definitions remain blocked.
r3_clarifications: Core7 does not require optional pore volume. Uncertain values are masked, not silently repaired.
The optional pore variant uses the same admitted cohort; missing values remain allowed for later fold-only imputation.
Baseline may be the author plotted start normalized to100pct, with exact cycle index retained as unknown.
Independence_checked denotes a bounded source and grouping review, not statistical independence of same-paper endpoints.
Freeze clearance addresses explicit record scope/conflict holds; missing current or window is still blocked by its own gate.
Eligibility never follows merely from the existence of seven numeric/categorical inputs.
